info.title: Reporting Metrics API
info.description:
# Introduction

Get all your Tenjin Data Exporter metrics through the API. To view a comprehensive list of metrics that you can report on, go to our Metric Definitions page.

An access token can be generated here.

## Access to the API

You can access the Reporting Metrics API via the following Base URL:

``` https://api.tenjin.com/v2/ ```

Bearer Authentication.description:
If you have an account on Tenjin you can generate an access token for accessing the Reporting Metrics API. You can learn more about authenticating with Tenjin in our documentation. Usage format: set the `Authorization` header to `Bearer `.

Rate Limiting

Reporting Metrics API requests are rate limited to prevent abuse and ensure stability. Each access token may make up to 100 reporting requests per minute. The Reporting Metrics API will respond with a 429 status code for subsequent requests above the rate limit.
